# cache/integration-tests

> 标签: cache, psr16, psr6, test

## 简介

Integration tests for PSR-6 and PSR-16 cache implementations

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 8；已收录于 php-v8。

## 官网

- 官网：https://github.com/php-cache/integration-tests
- 源码仓库：https://github.com/php-cache/integration-tests.git
- Packagist 页面：https://packagist.org/packages/cache%2Fintegration-tests
